title: Circuit Breaker #1 of 5 Image Comics 2016 Kevin McCarthy Kyle Baker Cover
condition_description: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Circuit-Breaker #1 (of 5) (March 2016), Image Comics - written by Kevin McCarthy, art and cover by Kyle Baker. A girl robot built to protect humanity, in a city full of giant anime-style robots. $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Four Eyes: Hearts of Fire (Joe Kelly, Max Fiumara) ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
